_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
O dula Golf (Kadi) - Player {player_id}.
Mmušo: Pata sko e tlase ka mošomo o le mongwe. Fa koloneng e na le tseno e le nngwe, di phephetšwa bjalo ka 0.
Madi a Kadi: A=1, 2-10=madi a a bonwa, J/Q=10, K=0

Tokelo (sebelisa kgwedi ka katlego):
- '[draw]' - Tswa mo dekini
- '[take]' - Tswa mo dipileng
- '[swap X Y]' - Feditse kadi e dumeletsegileng le poso X (lorero) Y (kholomo)
- '[discard]' - Iphela kadi e dumeletsegileng

board.drew:
O dumeletse: {card}
Jwale o swanetse [swap X Y] goba [discard]
board.took:
O dumeletse: {card} go tswa mo dipileng
O swanetse [swap X Y] na yona (ga a kgone go iphela)
board.peeked: O ile a bone ka poso ({row},{col}): {card}
board.none: Ga go na le e tee.

options.final_turns: Diturn tsa boraro! Dikamano tsa gago: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: O swanetše go: [swap X Y] (o ka se kgone go lahla dikarata tše di lego mokgobo wa tšeo o swanetšego go di lahla)

action_desc.swapped: Player {pid} o feditse {new} le {old} ka poso ({row},{col})

message.knocked: Sebapadi {pid} se kgorometšwe! Se sengwe le se sengwe sa dibapadi tše dingwe di hwetša sebaka se tee.
message.final_round: Player {pid} {reason}! Batho ba bangwe ba na turn e nngwe

reason.all_revealed: Na o utolotše dikarata ka moka?

invalid.wrong_action: Sebelisa tokelo e nngwe ya kgwedi: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], goba [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Mokgobo wa go lahla o se na selo!
invalid.must_draw_first: O swanetse go ❗️ [draw], [take], [knock], goba [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: O ka se ke wa lahla karata yeo e tšerwego mokgobong wo o lahlilwego. O swanetše go e fapanya.
invalid.have_drawn_card: O na le kadi e o e dumeletsegileng. O swanetse [swap X Y] goba [discard] yona
invalid.need_drawn_swap: O nyaka karata e swerwego gore o kgone go fapanyetša.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: O nyaka karata e swerwego gore o kgone go lahla.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Poso ke ntle le mabotho. Sebelisa lorero 1-{max_row}, kholomo 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: O ka se ke wa kokota ge o sa tšwa go ntšha karata. Phetha nako ya gago pele.
invalid.already_knocked: Motho yo mongwe o šetše a fentše mothalading wo.
invalid.already_revealed: Karata yeo e šetše e utolotšwe!
